## 7. Issues found and handling policy

| issue | handling |
|---|---|
| Field not reported in early years (null) | Keep null + missing-indicator; impute inside the train-only pipeline |
| Logical violations (e.g. DEP > ASSET) | Flag columns; exclude from ratios only if ASSET <= 0 |
| Negative equity | Keep: it is a genuine distress signal |
| Gaps in a bank's quarterly series | Keep rows; lag features computed by calendar quarter, not row order |
| Exit without failure | Label 0; last quarters flagged as censored/excluded (see 04_build_panel) |
| Failure with no Call Report | Cannot be modelled (no features); counted and reported |
| Reports after FAILDATE | Drop rows after FAILDATE |
| Extreme ratios | Winsorize inside the train-only pipeline |
